request.state:
L01: Shortbread wants very few things and a cold kitchen.
L02: Heat the oven to 150 degrees.
L03: Line a shallow tin with paper.
L04: Rub 250 grammes of cold butter into the flour.
L05: Add the sugar and work it to a crumb.
L06: Press the crumb into the tin with the back of a spoon.
L07: Prick it all over with a fork.
L08: Bake until the edges are pale gold.
L09: Cut it while it is still warm.
L10: Leave it in the tin until it is cold.
L11: It keeps a week in a tin and a day in a room of children.

q1.instructions: Which line gives how much butter the shortbread recipe uses?
